gen-gf-revalia-gf-sen: Sen reads tall and modern, drawn with one steady line. Under Revalia's wide-striding, bold display letters, a full paragraph would feel smooth and wire-thin, never tiring.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-sofia-sans: Stencil cuts and sprung-clip openings give Snowburst One real bite. And Sofia Sans answers with rounded, stylus-smooth letters standing tall, which is the pair's strongest single quality: loud on top, level below.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condens: Tektur's pipe-cleaner curves flare open at every turn. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed then carries a long paragraph smoothly, its tall lowercase and stencil-cut strokes keeping each line tidy and easy to follow.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-stack-sans-headline: Neon tubing meets crisp text. Stack Sans Headline brings monoline strokes and a deep middle band, and that sturdy, gap-spaced clarity is what Tilt Neon's glowing, splayed-terminal heading leans on.
gen-gf-turret-road-archivo: Round parentheses-like curves, drawn with a pen. Archivo steps in with a taller lowercase and outward-opening bowls, giving Turret Road's commanding display letters a plain sans partner that stays out of the way.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-asap: Turret Road's rope-like strokes and parenthesis-round forms give the heading a muscular, bold presence on the page. Asap sits taller and lighter beside it, quietly readable.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro has bent-steel strokes and a high mean line, so a long stretch of text feels crisp and clean. Be Vietnam Pro gives Turret Road's bold, pen-drawn rounds room to stand out.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-epilogue: Rounded forms like open parentheses, drawn in one pen-like line, make Turret Road unmistakable up top. Epilogue's curvy, tall lowercase handles the rest, though shrinking the heading would blunt it.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-fira-sans: Turret Road is all bold, parenthesis-round display letters drawn with a pen-like line. But Fira Sans does the quieter work, its generously open s curves and large x-height keeping text easy going.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-merriweather-sans: Parenthesis-round letters, with no hairlines at all. Merriweather Sans sits taller and lighter beside them, a plain sans whose open e keeps the heading's heft from crowding the text.
